_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. -The sensor for the south main lobby door has been ordered and the vendor will be onsite early next week to make the repair. -The fob system vendor was onsite until 830pm last night working on the doors. They moved cards to provide access. There are new cards that will arrive on Monday allowing them to complete the work. -For the south pool you may access through the gate on King. The gate by the building will not open. -For the south clubhouse you may enter the building through the rear lobby door. -For the north pool the gate on the side with the restrooms is working. The gate on the pro shop side will not open. -You may enter the north clubhouse through the main door or the restrooms.
